commands.command:
git diff -- README.md && printf '
--- files ---
' && rg --files -g 'README.md' -g 'build.py' -g 'tests/**' | sort && printf '
--- README ---
' && sed -n '1,240p' README.md && printf '
--- tests/test_readme.py ---
' && sed -n '1,320p' tests/test_readme.py

printf '%s
' '--- build.py ---' && sed -n '1,360p' build.py && printf '%s
' '--- status ---' && git status --short && printf '%s
' '--- tests ---' && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests && git diff -- README.md && git status --short -- README.md
